note: The library ratchet (DR-1266). Counted by lib/library-census.js over the catalog the tests mount (buildCatalogCourseDescriptors). readings, whole, allVersions and exams may only RISE; waiting may only FALL. A lesson that lands incomplete, or a version that is lost, fails the build. When the library improves, the test says so and this file is re-frozen BY HAND to the new counts, in the PR that improved it, never by a script.
